output_expectations.notes: Instance API: var options = new PdfToDocOptions(); options.SaveFormat = SaveFormat.DocX; options.AddInput(new FileDataSource('input.pdf')); options.AddOutput(new FileDataSource('output.docx')); new DocConverter().Process(options). CRITICAL: PdfConverterOptions is abstract — use PdfToDocOptions. SaveFormat.DocX (value=1) produces OOXML .docx (magic 50-4B-03-04). Default SaveFormat.Doc (value=0) produces OLE2 .doc. Harness-verified: ResultCollection.Count=1, DOCX magic 50-4B-03-04.
